retrievalProfile.description: A centered male studio portrait featuring high-contrast primary colors and soft analog film textures typical of early 1970s pop culture.
triggerTerms: vibrant cyan and red color block

recipe.visualDefinition: A medium-close-up portrait of a man with feathered 1970s hair, wearing a red v-neck sweater over a white collared shirt, set against a solid vibrant cyan-blue background with subtle analog texture and ring-wear artifacts.
coreVisualRelationships: Complementary contrast between the red sweater and cyan background
Triangular composition formed by the subject's shoulders and head
Soft, directional studio lighting creating gentle shadows on the face
Textural interplay between the knit fabric and the smooth backdrop

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centered, filling approximately 70% of the vertical frame from the waist up.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and eyes, positioned in the upper third of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye path starts at the face, moves down the white collar to the red sweater, and rests on the crossed arms at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Solid cyan space surrounding the head and shoulders, providing room for top-aligned typography.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Cyan-blue background providing a cool, saturated environment.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm red sweater acting as the primary subject focus.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Crisp white collar providing a high-value break between the face and sweater.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in both background and subject, with mid-tone values dominating the frame.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single font family used for both artist name and title to maintain 70s minimalist utility.
graphicDevices: Subtle circular 'ring wear' texture suggesting a vinyl record sleeve

candidateDirections.reason: Period-accurate geometric sans-serif with the correct weight and feel.
Provides the clean, geometric uppercase look seen in early 70s design.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a studio portrait of a man with 1970s feathered hair wearing a red v-neck sweater and white collar against a solid cyan background. Apply a soft film grain and a faint circular scuff texture.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add uppercase geometric sans-serif text in white at the very top edge, spaced widely to span the width of the frame.

verificationChecks: Is the background a saturated cyan?
Is the typography positioned at the extreme top edge?
Does the hair style reflect early 1970s trends?
Is there a visible white collar under the red sweater?

avoid: Modern sans-serif fonts like Helvetica Now

postGenerationChecks: Check for 'ring wear' texture on the edges
Verify the red and cyan balance is vibrant
Ensure the text is light-weight and uppercase
Confirm the lighting is soft and directional
recipe.reuseFormula: 1970s Studio Portrait [Subject] + Red/Cyan Color Block + Top-Aligned Geometric Sans-Serif + Analog Film Grain
